facts.fact: Disney's streaming platforms reach 157 million global monthly active users on ad-supported tiers, according to Disney's January 2025 announcement at CES.
facts.quote: Disney's streaming platforms now reach 157 million monthly active users on ad-supported tiers globally

facts.fact: The 157 million figure is an average per month over the prior six months, per Disney's methodology.
facts.quote: This figure represents an average per month over the prior six months.

facts.fact: Disney reports 112 million monthly active users on ad-supported content in the United States and Canada.
facts.quote: Domestically, in the United States and Canada, Disney reaches 112 million monthly active users on ad-supported content.

facts.fact: Disney reported 164 million monthly ad-supported viewers across its three streamers in May 2025, per a TheWrap report.
facts.quote: reported 164 million monthly ad-supported viewers

facts.fact: Disney's monthly ad-supported viewer figure grew 4% from the January 2025 announcement to May 2025.
facts.quote: a 4% increase in just four months

facts.fact: Of Disney's 157 million global ad-supported users, 112 million (71%) are in the United States and Canada.
facts.quote: 112 million (71%) are in the United States and Canada

facts.fact: Of Disney's 157 million global ad-supported users, 45 million (29%) come from international markets.
facts.quote: The remaining 45 million (29%) come from international markets

facts.fact: Disney's methodology applies a global average multiplier of 2.6 users per account to convert active accounts into estimated users.
facts.quote: Globally, the average multiplier is 2.6 users per account, though this varies by application and region.

facts.fact: Disney's co-viewing multipliers are determined from first-party survey data from more than 13,000 individuals ages 18-64 in regions with advertising tiers.
facts.quote: first-party survey data from more than 13,000 individuals ages 18-64 in regions with advertising tiers.

facts.fact: Disney counts an active account as one that has viewed ad-supported content continuously for more than 10 seconds.
facts.quote: have viewed ad-supported content continuously for more than 10 seconds.

facts.fact: Disney adds estimated active users across applications without de-duplication, so a subscriber with both Disney+ and Hulu ad-supported plans is counted in both tallies.
facts.quote: Disney's estimated active users are added across applications without de-duplication.
